name: Black Sun
content:
# Welcome to MicroPatterns!
# Display is 200x200

# Define patterns using DEFINE PATTERN
DEFINE PATTERN NAME="star" WIDTH=20 HEIGHT=20 DATA=""


VAR $rotation
LET $rotation=1

# Draw a line using FILL_PIXEL
# It will only draw where the background 'checker' pattern is 1
COLOR NAME=BLACK
FILL NAME="star" 

VAR $diag_pos

VAR $widthRatio = $WIDTH / 200

VAR $widthCenter = $WIDTH / 2
VAR $heightCenter = $HEIGHT /2

SCALE FACTOR=$widthRatio

REPEAT COUNT=$WIDTH TIMES
    TRANSLATE DX=$widthCenter DY=$heightCenter
    LET $diag_pos = $INDEX
    LET $rotation=$rotation+$second
    ROTATE DEGREES=$rotation
    REPEAT COUNT=10 TIMES
       ROTATE DEGREES=$rotation
       TRANSLATE DX=1 DY=1
       FILL_PIXEL X=$diag_pos Y=$diag_pos
    ENDREPEAT
   
     RESET_TRANSFORMS
ENDREPEAT
